title: MACA pointer-count inspection includes the comma in a valid TTGIR pointer type

evidence.failure: MACA kernel ABI is not a nonempty pointer-only signature

observation: The pointer-count reader delimited the type token only by whitespace, so a valid comma directly after the pointer type became part of that type and was rejected during stage sealing. This is a CPU contract reproduction, not a native compiler or device failure.
proposed_change: Treat a comma as an argument delimiter while preserving the closed pointer-only grammar. Replay comma-adjacent, spaced and multiline signatures; scalar parameters and unadmitted pointer forms remain refused.

verified_by.scope: CPU source/ABI parsing and sealed-stage fixture only; no device qualification follows.
